title: Additivity of coordinate projection
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $f,g:\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$. The coordinate projection that keeps the input coordinates in $J$ and averages over the remaining coordinates with respect to the product distribution induced by $\pi$ satisfies $P_J(f+g)=P_Jf+P_Jg$.
